# JAPONÉSON
> Cultural archives, oral histories, essays, and stories by Shoko "Seina" Shiraishi — a writer and musician based in Japan.

## Sections
- [About Seina](https://japoneson.com/en/about/): Background, musical roots, and dedications to Grady Tate and Bob Cranshaw.
- [JAPONÉSON](https://japoneson.com/en/cuba/): Study of post-revolution Cuban music, culture, and musical bridges.
- [Cupie Danny](https://japoneson.com/en/cupie/): The story of Danny Rojo and a 100-yen Cupie doll, and journeys from New York to Cuba. Galleries, the Theater and new activities are at https://cupiedanny.com/en/.
- [MURAKAMI MAMBO !!](https://japoneson.com/en/murakami/): Ryu Murakami through New York, Cuba, and Japan.
- [The Mystery Entertainment](https://japoneson.com/en/mystery/): Oral histories of Kanmon, General MacArthur, Korean War, and Allied POWs.
- [Angels Swing](https://japoneson.com/en/swing/): American popular songs of the 1930s-40s and the wartime history underneath.
- [Essays](https://japoneson.com/en/essay/): Personal essays, field encounters, and cultural reflections.
- [Cabin1701](https://cabin1701.com/): Sister sanctuary documenting human-AI co-creation and Living With AI.

## Markdown
- [About Seina as Markdown](https://japoneson.com/en/about.md): The main pages are also available as Markdown. Add `.md` to the page URL, without the trailing slash.
- [Essays as Markdown](https://japoneson.com/en/essay/a-door-for-cuba-in-2013.md): Every essay is also available as Markdown. Add `.md` to the essay URL, without the trailing slash.

## Feeds
- [RSS (English essays)](https://japoneson.com/en/rss.xml): All essays.
- [RSS (Español)](https://japoneson.com/es/rss.xml): All essays.
